main_post.text:
🔍 Hermes Agent Pod v0.1.0 - First Public Release

A local runtime kit that packages nousresearch/hermes-agent as a Kubernetes Pod or Docker Compose service. Codex delegates bounded subtasks to a nearby Hermes worker while keeping host-side control.

🎯 Architecture Highlights:
• Kind (Kubernetes) runtime + Docker Compose fallback
• Localhost gateway API at 127.0.0.1:8642
• Built-in Kanban dashboard at 127.0.0.1:9119
• OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint

⚙️ Worker Delegation:
The hermes-worker wrapper sends tasks with file attachments, session continuation, and JSON output. Codex stays in charge of host files and final decisions.

🔧 Default Config:
Aligned to Z.AI GLM Coding Plan — provider zai, model glm-5.1.

🛡️ Security-First:
Gateway is localhost-only by default. Runtime data and secrets stay local under data/ and .env*.

💡 Ideal for: Codex experimenters who want a sandboxed sub-agent without exposing API keys or host filesystem.

$ONIAGI
